t: Mapei Mapesil AC 130 is a reliable silicone sealant, supplied in a 310ml cartridge, crafted for diverse sealing applications. This solvent-free sealant is perfect for professional bathroom and kitchen installations, including sealing joints around sanitaryware, wash basins, bath tubs, and shower trays. Its robust formulation ensures strong waterproofing and resistance to mould, mildew, and common chemicals, providing a durable and hygienic seal. Suitable for interior and exterior use, it withstands temperatures up to 180°C. The jasmine colour precisely matches Mapei Ultracolour Plus Grout, offering a cohesive finish for tiling projects.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
